status_of_results: exploratory: every fight scored here has already been examined by CFL and by SYM-002
note: Frozen before any SYM-003 feature was built or scored. No feature may be added, removed or redefined after this file is committed; a change is a new experiment id.
inherits_from_SYM-002: features.parquet (23 point-in-time per-fighter inputs, seeded corner randomisation)
eligibility: both fighters >= 2 prior bouts with stats, DOB known, decided; evaluation rows also need an archived market price
outer test years 2021-2026, training rows from 2008-01-01, inner validation = last two calendar years of each training window, split by event date
baseline = SYM-002 'LR_linear': L2 logistic, no intercept, on the 23 standardised per-fighter differences, lambda chosen on inner validation from 1/C, C in {0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3}
fold-local preprocessing (z-score + clip +-4 per fighter, reach-from-height imputation), learned on the relevant training rows only

W_wrestling_matchup.W1_expected_takedowns: td15_A * tdag15_B / L_td15  -  td15_B * tdag15_A / L_td15
W_wrestling_matchup.W2_expected_control: ctrl_share_A * ctrl_against_B / L_ctrl  -  ctrl_share_B * ctrl_against_A / L_ctrl

S_striking_matchup.S1_expected_landed: slpm_A * sapm_B / L_slpm  -  slpm_B * sapm_A / L_slpm
S_striking_matchup.S2_expected_accuracy: str_acc_A * (1 - str_def_B) / L_acc  -  str_acc_B * (1 - str_def_A) / L_acc
S_striking_matchup.S3_expected_knockdowns: kd15_A * kdag15_B / L_kd15  -  kd15_B * kdag15_A / L_kd15

O_opponent_adjusted.aggregation: O_x = sum_b w_b r_b / (sum_b w_b + 15), w_b = minutes_b * 0.5 ** (days_before_fight_b / 730)
O_opponent_adjusted.features: O1..O6 = O_x(A) - O_x(B) for the six residuals

definitions.existing (SYM-002) per-fighter inputs: td15 = td_per15, ctrl_share, ctrl_against, td_acc, td_def, slpm, sapm, str_acc, str_def, kd15 = kd_per15; all career-cumulative over strictly prior bouts, shrunk with 25 pseudo-minutes (rates) / 50 or 10 pseudo-attempts (accuracies) toward the league value to date
definitions.new per-fighter inputs: tdag15 = takedowns conceded per 15 min, kdag15 = knockdowns conceded per 15 min; same 25-pseudo-minute shrinkage toward the league rate to date
definitions.L_*: league value over all bouts strictly before the fight date (the shrinkage prior). It is the same for both corners, so it only sets units
definitions.opp_pre(bout): the opponent's own point-in-time rate going INTO that historical bout, i.e. computed from the opponent's bouts strictly before that bout's date. Never the opponent's later career
definitions.per-bout actuals: from that bout's own totals: landed_per_min = sig landed / minutes, absorbed_per_min = opponent sig landed / minutes, td15 = 15 * td landed / minutes, td_against15 = 15 * opponent td landed / minutes, ctrl_share = own ctrl seconds / fight seconds, ctrl_against = opponent ctrl seconds / fight seconds

time_weighting.W, S: none beyond SYM-002's cumulative shrunk rates, deliberately: this isolates the value of the matchup COMBINATION from any recency change
time_weighting.O: minutes-weighted, exponential half-life 730 days measured from the fight being predicted

minimum_history.fighter: inherited cohort rule: >= 2 prior bouts with stats, so every new feature is defined for every eligible row
minimum_history.opponent_in_O: no minimum: an opponent with no prior stat bouts has league-prior pre-bout rates by construction (shrinkage), so that bout's residual is measured against the league average
minimum_history.bouts_used_in_O: only prior bouts with complete per-bout stats and fight time > 0

missing_data: after construction any NaN in a new feature is set to 0 (no matchup edge) and counted; expected count is 0 on eligible rows
preprocessing_new_features: each new feature divided by its standard deviation on the training rows of the relevant split (no centring, which would break antisymmetry), then clipped to +-5
symmetry: every new feature is f(A,B) - f(B,A); with no intercept, P(B,A) = 1 - P(A,B) exactly; checked on every test row
lambda_selection: per model, per fold, on inner validation log loss, from the same grid as the baseline
pre_fit_diagnostic: R^2 of each new feature regressed on the 23 baseline differences over 2008-2020 training rows. Outcome-free. R^2 >= 0.9 is reported as 'largely already represented'

evaluation.uncertainty: event-level bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 7, of each model minus baseline
evaluation.improvement_rule: same as SYM-002: the 95% event-bootstrap interval of the pooled 2021-2025 log-loss difference vs baseline lies entirely below zero AND the model beats baseline in at least 4 of 5 folds
evaluation.market: archived consensus on the identical cohort, labelled 'timestamps unverified'

decision_rules.further_symbolic_search: only if at least one group meets the improvement rule
decision_rules.freeze_for_future_fights: fit every model once on all eligible rows through 2026-10-03 (inner validation 2025-2026) and hash them. Pre-designated primary prospective comparison: the group that met the rule vs baseline; if none met it, baseline+all vs baseline as a challenger test
forbidden: adding or editing features after seeing results
